customManagers.description: Grimmory's container image tag. Nothing in config:best-practices looks for Docker references inside .nix files, so srv-01's one image would otherwise never be offered an update.

packageRules.description: Never automerge the container image. :automergeMinor would otherwise merge it on green CI, and CI only builds the closure — it never starts the container, so nothing there can tell a working image from a broken one.
